Name: Em's Dodo's
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Flightless, extinct and living in a coop!
Add dodos to Marnie's shop. Including eggs, feathers, mayo and recipes
Available for CP and AT (chickens)
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/4Nrh8NFM/Dodo-Items.gif[/img]

Dodos lay one speckled egg a day. These small eggs can be put in the incubator to hatch or used to make dodo mayo
Place the egg in the mayo machine, and it produces a creamy, slightly speckled mayo

If you're lucky, you might even find a dodo egg out in the wild when digging up an artefact spot
Use the stovetop or campfire to make a delicious dodo omelette with double yolks!

The feathers of a dodo are small and stubby. Use the [i]config.json[/i] to set your feather colour preference to either "[color=#e69138]Brown[/color], [color=#e69138]white[/color] or [color=#e69138]blue[/color]"
Use the feathers to craft a fossil as decoration around your farm, or frame them to hang on your wall

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Dodo's CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

When hatching or buying a dodo from Marnie, the type gets randomised and can be any of the included options
If you rather choose which type you buy, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]
